view: Frontal chest radiograph, PA projection (mirror-imaged L marker on the image right = patient's left; conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Adequate. Inspiration adequate (~9-10 posterior ribs visible); penetration adequate (thoracic spine visible through the cardiac shadow); no significant rotation (medial clavicular ends roughly symmetric about the spinous processes); scapulae partially projected over the lateral upper lung fields; entire thorax included, lower image edge cuts through the upper abdomen.

devices.type: Small radiopaque bar, probably part of the same external object
devices.location: Inferior image edge, over the patient's left upper abdomen

Small well-defined dense nodule ~0.3-0.4 cm lateral to the aortic knob, most consistent with a calcified granuloma
Aortic knob / left superior mediastinal contour prominent for a 34-year-old

description_zh: 胸部正面（PA）X光，吸氣深度及穿透度尚可、無明顯旋轉；胸腔內未見任何導管、引流管或植入裝置，影像左下角（病人右側脅腹／上腹部）見一粗弧形體外高密度影（電線／管路或鉛遮蔽物邊緣），左上腹另見一微小「S」形高密度影，疑為體外雜訊。右肺野清晰；左側肺門較對側顯著且密度增加，主動脈弓結以此年齡而言略為突出，左中肺野主動脈弓外側見約0.3–0.4公分之緻密小結節（疑鈣化性肉芽腫），左中下肺野心臟外側可見約6公分範圍模糊之網狀結節狀密度增加（部分可能為乳房陰影重疊，但較對側明顯）。心臟大小正常、氣管居中；雙側肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液、氣胸或明確之肋膜增厚／肺尖帽；骨骼結構及軟組織無明顯異常。
